title: Understanding Ourselves and Others
text: Explore your personal identity and understand how heritage and values shape your worldview.
cdi_links: 3.G.05 Reflecting on personal identity, values, and influences on decision-making

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: What identity means and how it develops
How heritage influences who you are
The importance of values and beliefs
How your worldview shapes your decisions

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can describe my identity
I can explain how heritage influences people
I can identify my values and beliefs
I can explain how my worldview affects my choices

title: Key Words
bullets: Identity – Who you are, including your personality and beliefs
Heritage – Where your family comes from and traditions they follow
Values – The things that matter most to you, such as honesty or fairness
Worldview – Your way of understanding life based on beliefs and experiences

title: Quick Questions
text: What makes you who you are?
What values are most important to you?
How might your background influence your decisions?

title: Identity and Worldview
bullets: Everyone has a unique way of seeing the world
This is called a worldview
Your worldview is shaped by beliefs, experiences, and values
Understanding this helps you make sense of your choices and opinions

title: Heritage, Values, and Beliefs
bullets: Heritage includes your background, culture, and traditions
Values are the things that matter most to you
Beliefs guide how you think about life
These factors work together to shape your identity

title: Activity
text: Take part in activities that explore your identity, values, beliefs, and heritage. Reflect on what matters to you, how your background influences you, and how these factors shape your worldview and decisions.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Your identity is shaped by your experiences, beliefs, and background
Heritage, values, and beliefs influence your worldview
Understanding yourself helps you make informed decisions
Reflection supports personal growth and self-awareness
